  • Field Details

    • VAR_PATTERN

      static final Pattern VAR_PATTERN
      Pattern matching CSS variable references like $variable-name. Variable names can contain letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens, but must start with a letter or underscore.

  • Method Details

    • resolveVariables

      static String resolveVariables(String value, Map<String,String> variables)
      Resolves variable references in a value.

      This method extracts all $variable patterns from the input string and replaces each with its value from the variables map. This approach is deterministic regardless of the iteration order of the variables map, because resolution is driven by the patterns found in the input string rather than by iterating over the map.

      Parameters:
      value - the value that may contain $variable references
      variables - the variables map
      Returns:
      the resolved value
